skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Season of Travel
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Season of Travel. Pinecone's outfit while visiting family in Columbia. The jacket's jade trim outlines the simple dress with a vibrant aura. An unintentional pairing, yet perfect for spring.
skins.quote: Pinecone is about to leave that small town once more. Knowing his daughter no longer has to worry about the future, the laborer suddenly stuffs a doll into her hands. She stares at it in a daze, but luckily the little guy waves a hand in her stead.

skins.name: Sing a Song
skins.content: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Sing a Song. After passing her audition, Pinecone took to the stage with no especially strong desire to be an idol. She just wants to sing.
skins.quote: A light-hearted nursery rhyme with simple lyrics that you never get tired of, no matter how many times you sing.
